name: EPIC 205968148
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 3, 13.2 solar radii and 0.84 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 4,282 parsecs away, 13 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 3, give 0.84 solar masses and 13.2 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,564 K at its surface.
